name: Parfait Sucreal
original_name: パルフェ・シュクレール
source:
Flore's best friend and her classmate at the Academy of Magic. Parfait is the energetic daughter of the woman who owns "Black Cat Magic Shop".

Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%81%8A%E8%8A%B1%E7%95%91%E3%81%AE%E3%83%95%E3%83%AD%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AC]Wikipedia[/url].]
